purpose: Independent, separately-produced career-strength ratings trail, staged ONLY as a cross-check / scale-calibration reference. NEVER a rating source, never per-card-copied, never blended into our ratings.
produced_by: wcdraft-recon (separate local project at /Users/paulo/Projects/wcdraft-recon) — Player Career-Strength Rating Model v1.1 (Phase 3C).

files.note: The full/richest recon output: carries provenance columns (rating_basis, source_count, sources_json, override_type, notes, birth_date, era_bucket) needed for divergence auditing. Chosen over the 19-column app_clean ingestion variant, which TRIMS exactly those provenance columns and is intended for per-card ingestion — not what a cross-check needs.

external_provenance_trail.note: Authoritative provenance/IP evidence lives OUTSIDE this repo (it cites proprietary product names as EXCLUSIONS, which must not enter the firewalled tree). Cited here by absolute path for auditability; not copied in.

source_basis.structure_and_merit: Fjelstul World Cup Database (CC-BY-SA 4.0, Joshua C. Fjelstul, Ph.D.) — players, squads, goals, matches, team_appearances. The secondary world_cup_merit_score field is a deterministic function of this DB only (the recon 'worldcup_game' model = the World Cup DRAFT-GAME merit model, NOT a video-game rating).
source_basis.anchors_and_overrides: Curated public-knowledge career-strength claims for ~3.2% of players, each citing award/honors/editorial sources (Ballon d'Or, South American / IFFHS player-of-the-year, FIFA governing-body awards, IFFHS/RSSSF century lists, FIFA 100 living-legends, Wikipedia, public consensus).
source_basis.fallback: Remaining ~96.8% use deterministic position/tier templates + small era/merit adjustments (conservative defaults, confidence=low).

ip_determination.basis: Award / fact / editorial sourced. No proprietary game-rating IP is fetched, parsed, or referenced in the data trail.
ip_determination.proprietary_game_rating_dbs: EXCLUDED and documented as not-used in the recon source registry. The committed reference CSV is token-clean against the canonical block list (PROPRIETARY_SOURCE_TOKENS in etl/src/wcdraft_etl/merit/__init__.py / _PROPRIETARY_PATTERN in etl/tests/test_rating.py): 0 hits across all 8482 rows.
ip_determination.fifa_note: The token 'FIFA' appears only as the GOVERNING BODY's honors/awards (FIFA World Cup awards, The Best, FIFA 100) — an admissible recognition source — never as the video-game rating product, which the canonical block list catches and which returns 0 hits.
